title: Israel Demands a King
reflectionText: The elders had a fair complaint — Samuel was old, and his sons took bribes. But what they asked for was to be like all the other nations. Yahweh told Samuel the deeper thing: it was not Samuel they were rejecting, but God as their king. He warned them plainly what a king would cost, and still they wanted one, and he let them have it. When has "like everyone else" been the thing you most wanted?
editorialNotes: PAL Daily supervised production 2026-07-26, Batch F. 1 Samuel 8:1-22 ONLY.
